Description: Key West is the southernmost city in the continental US, home to Naval Air Station Key West (fighter adversary and air-defense training) at the end of the Florida Keys. It pairs a tropical climate, an in-city VA outpatient clinic, and Florida's no-income-tax treatment of military retirement with a nationally known, welcoming culture. The overriding tradeoff is cost: the typical home tops $1 million, there is no Walmart or Costco on the island, and gas runs well above the state average.
